seo.description: Learn how Test-English.com uses cookies to enhance your experience. Read our Cookie Policy to manage your preferences and privacy settings.

html:
Understanding How We Use Cookies

Test-English fully endorses and adheres to the principles of data protection, as set out in the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) 2018. This Cookie Policy is an outline of how we handle information we learn about you from your visit to our website.

What are cookies?

Cookies are simple text files that are stored on your computer or mobile device by a website’s server. Each cookie is unique to your web browser. It will contain some anonymous information such as a unique identifier, website’s domain name, and some digits and numbers. A cookie never stores personal information, such as name, address, email address, or telephone number.

What types of cookies do we use?

Necessary cookies

Necessary cookies allow us to offer you the best possible experience when accessing and navigating through our website and using its features.

Advertising cookies

We use third-party advertising companies to serve ads when you visit our website. These companies may use information (not including your name, address, email address, or telephone number) about your visits to this and other websites in order to provide advertisements about goods and services of interest to you.

Analytical cookies

This website uses Google Analytics. Google Analytics uses cookies which we use to collect aggregated data for statistical purposes on how our visitors use the website so as to improve their experience using our website. These cookies do not contain personal information.

How to change your cookie preferences?

If you want to change your cookie consent, please visit our cookie declaration.

Contact us

If you have any questions about this cookie policy or our use of cookies, please contact us.
